title: MqntellaSMP
description: This is an Unstable inspired server featuring the classic Unstable map, custom kits, and an active community. Join for PvP and SMP fun:)
body:
🔥 Mqntella SMP - Unstable Inspired! 🔥
Experience Unstable-style kits, an awesome custom map, and fast-paced PvP action. We're currently recruiting staff, so if you want to help run the server, now's your chance! Every new player also gets a FREE map download. Join our growing community, battle other players, and become part of something epic!
